Kaayyoon isaanii kanneenis gargaarsa waraana Ingiliiz Israa'elif taasisaa jirtu gufachiisuu akka ta'e beekameera.

title: Former NBA player Enes Kanter ejected after confrontation with WNBA’s Cloud
english: Former NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom was removed from a WNBA game between the Chicago Sky and Indiana Fever following a heated verbal exchange with player Natasha Cloud. Kanter, who was sitting courtside wearing a shirt expressing his views on gender, approached the court after Cloud confronted him during a timeout. Security intervened to separate the two, leading to Kanter's ejection from the arena, while Cloud later emphasized her support for the trans community on social media.
amharic: የቀድሞው የኤንቢኤ ተጫዋች ኤነስ ካንተር ፍሪደም በቺካጎ ስካይ እና በኢንዲያና ፋቨር መካከል በተደረገው የደብሊውኤንቢኤ ጨዋታ ወቅት ከተጫዋች ናታሻ ክላውድ ጋር በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ከስፍራው ተባረረ። ካንተር በጨዋታው ወቅት ስለ ጾታ ያለውን አመለካከት የሚያሳይ ቲሸርት ለብሶ በሜዳው አቅራቢያ ተቀምጦ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ክላውድ በጨዋታው እረፍት ጊዜ እርሱን በመቃወሟ ወደ ሜዳው በመቅረቡ ግጭት ተፈጥሯል። የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ጣልቃ በመግባት ካንተርን ከሜዳው ያወጡት ሲሆን፣ ክላውድ በኋላ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ለትራንስጀንደር ማህበረሰብ ያላትን ድጋፍ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Taphataan NBA duraanii Enes Kanter Freedom, tapha WNBA kan Chicago Sky fi Indiana Fever gidduutti gaggeeffamaa ture irratti taphattuu Natasha Cloud waliin wal-dhabdee uumameen dirree irraa arii'ameera. Kanter, uffata waa'ee saalaa ilaalchisee yaada isaa ibsu uffatee gubbaa dirree taa'aa osoo jiruu, erga Cloud isa qeequu jalqabdee booda gara dirree itti dhihaate. Eegdonni nageenyaa gidduu seenuun Kanterin ganda taphichaa keessaa baasanii jiru; erga taatee kanaa booda Cloud miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti hawaasa tiransijendaraaf deggarsa qabdu ibsiteetti.

title: Israel accused of using kites as pretext to justify escalating Gaza attacks
english: Israel has launched deadly airstrikes across Gaza, claiming they are a response to children flying kites and balloons from the area. While Israeli officials justify these attacks as a security necessity, critics argue that the government is using these harmless toys as a fake pretext to intensify violence and undermine potential ceasefire talks. Recent strikes have resulted in several casualties, including a young child, despite reports confirming that the kites posed no real threat.
amharic: እስራኤል በጋዛ ህጻናት በሚያበሯቸው ወረቀት መጫወቻዎች እና ፊኛዎች ምክንያት ነው በሚል ከፍተኛ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽማለች። የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱን ለደህንነት ሲባል አስፈላጊ ነው ቢሉም፣ ተቺዎች ግን መንግስት ይህንን ሰበብ በመጠቀም ጥቃቱን ለማጠናከር እና የተኩስ አቁም ድርድርን ለማደናቀፍ እየሞከረ ነው ሲሉ ይከሳሉ። ጥቃቱ ምንም አይነት ፈንጂ በሌላቸው መጫወቻዎች ምክንያት የተፈጸመ ቢሆንም፣ የበርካታ ሰዎች ህይወት መጥፋቱን ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ ቁጣ ቀስቅሷል።
oromo: Israa'el daa'imman Gaazaatti xuurommii (kites) fi fuyyee akka taphataatti fayyadamaa turan sababa godhachuun haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwatteetti. Mootummaan Israa'el haleellaa kana nageenyaaf barbaachisaa dha jedhee kan falmu ta'us, qorattoonni garuu mootummaan kun gocha kana akka sababaatti fayyadamuun haleellaa isaa jabeessuufi marii dhaabbii waraanaa gufachiisuu akka barbaadu ibsu. Haleellaa kanaan yeroo xuurommiin sun dhoontuu hin qabaachuu isaanii mirkanaa'e jiruus, ijoollee dabalatee lubbuun namoota baay'ee darbeera.

title: Cambuur fans suffer burns as fireworks set off during Dutch league match
english: During a Dutch league football match, Feyenoord supporters threw fireworks at Cambuur fans, causing burns, eye injuries, and hearing damage to several attendees. The game was briefly suspended, but officials allowed it to continue despite the violence. Both the local authorities and the Dutch football association are now investigating the incident and reviewing safety protocols for future matches.
amharic: በኔዘርላንድስ የሊግ እግር ኳስ ጨዋታ ወቅት የፌይኖርድ ደጋፊዎች በተቃራኒ ቡድን ደጋፊዎች ላይ ርችቶችን በመወርወራቸው በርካታ የካምቡር ደጋፊዎች ላይ የቃጠሎ፣ የዓይን እና የመስማት ችግር ደርሷል። ጨዋታው ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ቢቋረጥም፣ ግጭቱ ቢኖርም ዳኞች ጨዋታው እንዲቀጥል ፈቅደዋል። የኔዘርላንድስ እግር ኳስ ማህበር እና የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ እየጀመሩ ሲሆን፣ የወደፊት የደህንነት ደንቦችንም ለመገምገም ወስነዋል።
oromo: Tapha kubbaa miilaa biyya Neezarlaandi irratti, deggertoonni garee Feyenoord deggertoota garee Cambuur irratti firaaywarkiin roobsisuun namoota hedduu irratti gubaa, miidhaa ijaa fi gurraa geessisaniiru. Taphi kun yeroo gabaabaaf addaan citus, miidhaan gahuu isaa irra iyyuu abbootiin taayitaa taphichi akka itti fufu hayyamaniiru. Waldaan kubbaa miilaa Neezarlaandi fi bulchiistonni naannichaa dhimmicha qorachaa jiru akkasumas seera eegumsa fayyaa fi tasgabbii gara fuulduraa irratti jijjiirama gochuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Colombia lifts coal export ban on Israel imposed over Gaza genocide
english: Colombia's new right-wing administration has officially overturned the previous government's coal export ban on Israel. President Abelardo de la Espriella, who took office recently, is reversing former leader Gustavo Petro's policies as part of a broader move to strengthen diplomatic and economic ties with Israel. This decision restores a vital energy supply for Israel, marking a significant shift in Colombia's international stance on the conflict in Gaza.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያ አዲስ የቀኝ ዘመም መንግስት ከዚህ ቀደም በኢስራኤል ላይ ተጥሎ የነበረውን የድንጋይ ከሰል ንግድ ክልከላ አነሳ። አዲሱ ፕሬዚዳንት አቤላርዶ ደ ላ እስፕሪኤላ የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት ጉስታቮ ፔትሮ የነበሩትን ፖሊሲዎች በመቀየር ከኢስራኤል ጋር ያላቸውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ እና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ግንኙነት እያጠናከሩ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ውሳኔ ለኢስራኤል የኃይል አቅርቦትን እንደገና የሚፈቅድ ሲሆን በጋዛ ጦርነት ላይ የኮሎምቢያን የውጭ ግንኙነት አቋም በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀይሮታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Kolombiyaa haaraan mirgaa, dhorkaa ergaa cimaa (coal) Israa'eel irratti duraan turerraa kaaseera. Pireezidaantiin haaraan Abelardo de la Espriella, siyaasa pireezidaantii duraanii Gustaavo Peetroo jijjiiruun hariiroo dippilomaasii fi diinagdee Israa'eel wajjin qaban cimsuuf tarkaanfii fudhataniiru. Murteen kun Israa'eelif gargaarsa anniisaa deebisee kan kennu yoo ta'u, gama siyaasaa alaa Kolombiyaan waraana Gaazaa ilaalchisee qabdu jijjiiruu isaati.

title: Photos: Towering landfill collapse kills 30 in Guinea’s capital, Conakry
english: At least 30 people died and six were injured after a massive pile of trash collapsed at a landfill in Conakry, Guinea, following heavy rain. The landslide destroyed several homes in a nearby residential area where families were still living despite receiving eviction notices. Authorities are now focusing on rescue efforts and the relocation of survivors from the disaster site.
amharic: በጊኒ ዋና ከተማ ኮናክሪ በጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት አንድ ትልቅ የቆሻሻ መጣያ በመደርመሱ ቢያንስ 30 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ ስድስት ሰዎችም ቆስለዋል። የቆሻሻ ክምር መደርመሱ በአካባቢው የነበሩ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን አውድሟል፤ ቤተሰቦችም ከመኖሪያቸው እንዲለቁ ትእዛዝ ተሰጥቷቸው የነበረ ቢሆንም አደጋው ሲከሰት አሁንም በስፍራው ነበሩ። መንግስት የሟቾችን ቁጥር ማረጋገጥና በስፍራው የሚገኙ ነዋሪዎችን ወደ ሌላ ቦታ የማዛወር ስራ እየሰራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Magaalaa Gini, Konakrii keessatti rooba cimaan booda xubbiin kosii guddaan tokko hojjaa’ee namoota 30 ol ajjeeseera, jahan immoo miidheera. Kosii kanaan manni jireenyaa hedduun manca’aniiru, jiraattonnis bakka sanaa akka gadhiisan himamee kan ture ta’us, utuu hin ba’in balaan kun isaan mudateera. Aangoonni mootummaa amma xiyyeeffannoo isaanii namoota caccabaa kosii jala jiran barbaaduu fi warra lubbuun hafan bakka biraatti qubachiisuurratti taasisaniiru.

title: Sanctions didn't break Iran. They hardened it
english: Despite severe international sanctions, a naval blockade, and significant economic challenges like soaring inflation, Iran's economy has avoided total collapse. The nation's limited integration with global financial markets and lack of foreign debt have acted as a buffer, preventing typical capital flight and financial panic. Instead of breaking under the pressure, the Iranian system has adapted, with domestic markets even hitting record highs during the conflict.
amharic: ምንም እንኳን ኢራን ከፍተኛ ዓለም አቀፍ ማዕቀቦች፣ የባህር ላይ እገዳዎች እና ከፍተኛ የዋጋ ንረት ቢገጥማትም፣ ኢኮኖሚዋ ሙሉ በሙሉ ከመውደቅ ተርፏል። አገሪቱ ከዓለም አቀፍ የፋይናንስ ሥርዓት ጋር ያላት ጥብቅ ቁርኝት እና የውጭ ዕዳ አለመኖር፣ ካፒታል ወደ ውጭ እንዳይወጣ እና የፋይናንስ ቀውስ እንዳይፈጠር አግዷቸዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት፣ ኢራን በግፊት ከመፍረስ ይልቅ፣ በጦርነቱ ወቅት ሳይቀር የሀገር ውስጥ ገበያዎቿ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ በመድረስ ሁኔታውን መቋቋም ችለዋል።
oromo: Iran keessaatti qormaanni diinagdee cimaan, uggurri gabaa fi gatiin meeshaalee dabaluus, diinagdeen biyyattii guutummaatti hin kufuun hafeera. Walitti dhufeenyi biyyattii gabaa addunyaa waliin qabdu kan daangeffame ta'uu fi liqii alaa muraasa qabaachuun ishee, diinagdeen biyyattii akka hin kufne fi gabaan hin raafamne gargaareera. Dhiibbaa irra jiraatullee, sirni Iran kanatti goruun, yeroo waraanaas gabaan keessoo biyyattii sadarkaa ol'aana irra ga'uun danda'ameera.

title: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has warned Iran of an unprecedented financial assault, pledging to isolate the country economically and penalize any nations that continue to support it. In response, Iran has threatened to block all regional oil exports and restrict movement through the critical Strait of Hormuz. This escalation marks a significant tightening of tensions as the US seeks to completely cut off the Iranian regime's financial lifelines.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት ኢራን ከዚህ በፊት ታይቶ በማይታወቅ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እንደምትቀጣ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ኢራንን ብቻ ሳይሆን ከእርሷ ጋር የኢኮኖሚ ግንኙነት ያላቸውን ሀገራትም እንደሚያካትት ገልጸዋል። በምላሹ ኢራን በክልሉ የሚደረገውን የነዳጅ ንግድ እንደምትዘጋና የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን እንደምትቆጣጠር በማስፈራራት ውጥረቱ ተባብሷል።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Ameerikaa Iskoottii Besent, Iran irratti duula diinagdee cimaa fi kanaan dura hin mul'anne akka banan ibsaniiru. Duulli kun Iran qofa osoo hin taane, biyyoota ishee wajjin quunnamtii diinagdee qaban hundas kan adabu ta'a jedhaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Iran dhaabbilee boba'aa naannichaa cufuufi daandii galaana Hormuz to'achuun Ameerikaa akkasumas gartuu ishee akeekkachiisteetti.

title: India used pellets, grenades on Gen Z protests: What Amnesty report reveals
english: Amnesty International has released a report confirming that Indian security forces used aggressive weapons, including pellet guns and electric shock devices, against young protesters in New Delhi last July. The demonstrations were sparked by widespread anger over national examination paper leaks and resulted in over 100 student injuries. While the government maintains that its response was restrained, the human rights organization highlights that these tactics violated official safety guidelines.
amharic: የአምነስቲ ኢንተርናሽናል ዘገባ እንዳመለከተው በባለፈው ሐምሌ ወር በኒው ዴሊ በተካሄደ የተማሪዎች ተቃውሞ ላይ የሕንድ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች የጎማ እና የብረት ጥይቶችን እንዲሁም የኤሌክትሪክ ንዝረት መሳሪያዎችን መጠቀማቸውን አረጋግጧል። ተቃውሞው የተቀሰቀሰው በብሔራዊ የፈተና ወረቀት መፍሰስ ሳቢያ በተፈጠረ ቅሬታ ሲሆን፣ በደረሰው ጥቃትም ከ100 በላይ ተማሪዎች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። መንግሥት እርምጃው ተገቢ እንደነበር ቢገልጽም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተቋሙ የተጠቀሱት መሳሪያዎች የሕንድን የደህንነት መመሪያዎች የሚጥሱ መሆናቸውን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Gabaasni 'Amnesty International' akka ibsetti, ji’a darbe magaala New Delhi keessatti hiriira barattootaa irratti humnoonni nageenyaa Indiyaa meeshaalee cimaa kanneen akka qawwee dhukaasu, gaazii imimmaansuu fi meeshaalee elektiriikii fayyadamuu isaanii mirkaneesseera. Hiriirri kun kan ka’e rakkoo qormaata biyyoolessaa fi hanqina barnootaa irratti mufachuu irraa yoo ta’u, miidhaan barattoota 100 ol irra ga’eera. Mootummaan tarkaanfiin fudhatame sirrii akka ta’e dubbatus, dhaabbatichi meeshaaleen kunneen dambii nageenyaa biyyattii cabsuu isaanii fi tarkaanfii hammaataadhas jedheera.

title: Dutch public broadcaster to boycott ‘no longer’ neutral Eurovision
english: The Dutch broadcaster AVROTROS has decided to boycott the next Eurovision Song Contest, stating that the competition has lost its neutrality amid international conflicts. They believe recent rule changes by organizers are not enough to address the divisiveness caused by the ongoing war in Gaza. This follows a period where several nations have protested the event due to Israel's participation.
amharic: የደች የህዝብ ስርጭት አገልግሎት (AVROTROS) በዓለም አቀፍ ግጭቶች ምክንያት የዩሮቪዥን ዘፈን ውድድር ገለልተኛነቱን አጥቷል በሚል በሚቀጥለው ዓመት ውድድሩ ላይ እንደማይሳተፍ አስታውቋል። አዘጋጆቹ በውድድሩ ላይ ያደረጓቸው ለውጦች በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ተከትሎ የተፈጠረውን ክፍፍል ለመፍታት በቂ እንዳልሆኑ ድርጅቱ ገልጿል። እስራኤል በውድድሩ ላይ በመሳተፏ ሳቢያ በርካታ ሀገራት ተቃውሟቸውን ሲያሰሙ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni oduu biyya Netherlands (AVROTROS) walitti bu'iinsa idil-addunyaa irraa kan ka'e, dorgommiin faaruu Eurovision of danda'aa ta'uu isaa waan dhabeef dorgommii dhufu irratti akka hin hirmaanne murteesseera. Jijjiiramoonni qophiin dorgommichaa taasise, waraana Gaazaatiin walqabatee rakkoo uumame hiikuuf gahaa miti jedhaniiru. Murteen kun biyyoonni hedduun hirmaannaa Israa'el mormuun dorgommicha keessaa ba'uu isaanii hordofee kan dhufe dha.

title: Israel continues to hold abducted Palestinian doctor after reported heart attack
english: Israeli forces arrested Palestinian gynecologist Dima Amin from her home in Ramallah over allegations related to her social media activity. Following her detention, the 54-year-old doctor suffered a heart-related medical emergency that required a hospital procedure. Despite her family's concerns and lack of access to medical reports, Israeli authorities have extended her detention until at least next Monday.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በፍልስጤማዊቷ የማህፀን ሐኪም ዲማ አሚን ላይ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ልጥፎች ምክንያት በራማላህ በሚገኘው መኖሪያ ቤታቸው ወረራ ፈጽመው አስረዋታል። የ54 ዓመቷ ሐኪም በእስር ላይ እያሉ በልባቸው ላይ በደረሰ ችግር ምክንያት ሆስፒታል ገብተው ህክምና እንዲያደርጉ ተገደዋል። ቤተሰቦቻቸው የጤንነታቸውን ሁኔታ በተመለከተ መረጃ ለማግኘት ቢቸገሩም፣ የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት እስራቸውን ቢያንስ እስከ ሰኞ ድረስ አራዝመዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el ogeettii fayyaa dubartootaa Falastiin kan ta'an Dima Amin, ergaa miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti maxxansaniin walqabatee mana isaanii kan Ramallaah jiru weeraruun hidhaniiru. Umuriin isaanii waggaa 54 kan ta'an ogeettiin fayyaa kun, erga hidhamanii booda rakkoo onnee mudatee hospitaala seenanii yaalamuun isaanii gabaafameera. Maatiin isaanii waa'ee fayyaa isaanii baruuf yaalaa kan jiran ta'us, mootummaan Israa'el hidhaa isaanii hanga guyyaa Wiixataatti dheeressaniiru.

title: Russia's second-biggest online retailer targeted in Ukrainian strikes
english: Ukrainian drone strikes have targeted logistics warehouses belonging to Ozon, Russia's second-largest online retailer, causing major fires in several southern regions. While the company reported injuries and evacuations, Russian officials stated that a drone attack in the Krasnodar region also resulted in the deaths of three children. This escalation follows similar strikes on the retailer Wildberries, prompting warnings from President Putin that Russia will retaliate against sensitive Ukrainian economic sectors.
amharic: የዩክሬን ድሮኖች የሩሲያ ሁለተኛው ትልቁ የመስመር ላይ ቸርቻሪ የሆነውን የኦዞን መጋዘኖችን በመምታታቸው በበርካታ ደቡባዊ አካባቢዎች ከፍተኛ እሳት ተቀስቅሷል። ኩባንያው ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሰዎች መኖራቸውን እና ሰራተኞች መፈናቀላቸውን የገለጸ ሲሆን የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት በክራስኖዶር አካባቢ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ሶስት ህጻናት መገደላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ክስተት ከዚህ ቀደም በሌላ ትልቅ ቸርቻሪ በዋይልድቤሪስ ላይ ከተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ጋር ተያይዞ የመጣ ሲሆን ፕሬዝዳንት ፑቲን በምላሹ በዩክሬን ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥቃት እንደሚሰነዝሩ አስፈራርተዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Yukreeni, dhaabbata gurgurtaa intarneetii kan Raashiyaa isa lammaffaa guddaa ta'e 'Ozon' irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee (drone) gaggeessuun, buufataaleen isaa hedduun ibiddan barbadoofaniiru. Dhaabbatichi miidhaa fi buqqa'iinsa hojjettootaa gabaasee jira; gamtaa gamaatiin, mootummaan Raashiyaa haleellaa kanaan daa'imman sadii naannoo Krasnodaritti du'uu isaanii beeksiseera. Haleellaan kun kan hordofe haleellaa dhaabbata 'Wildberries' irratti raawwatame yoo ta'u, Preezidaant Puutiin qabeenya dinagdee Yukreen irratti haaloo akka ba'an akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: US threatens toughest sanctions yet against Iran: What we know
english: The United States is planning to impose its most severe economic sanctions to date against Iran in an effort to collapse the country's government. President Donald Trump has warned that any nation continuing to trade with or support Iran will face significant economic consequences. In response, Tehran has vowed to retaliate against any country that participates in these new American measures.
amharic: አሜሪካ የኢራንን መንግስት ለማዳከም እስካሁን ካደረገችው ሁሉ የከፋ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ለመጣል እያቀደች ነው። ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት የሚያደርጉ ወይም ድጋፍ የሚሰጡ ማናቸውም ሀገራት ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ቅጣት እንደሚጠብቃቸው አስጠንቅቀዋል። ኢራን በበኩሏ በአዲሶቹ የአሜሪካ ማዕቀቦች ላይ ለሚሳተፉ ሀገራት ሁሉ የበቀል እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Ameerikaan mootummaa Iraan laamsheessuuf jedhee hanga ammaatti kan hin mul'anne tarkaanfii diinagdee cimaa ta'e irratti fudhachuuf karoorfateera. Preezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp biyyi kamiyyuu Iraan waliin daldaluu ykn gargaarsa gochuu itti fufte miidhaa diinagdee cimaa akka qaqqabsiisu akeekkachiisaniiru. Iraan gama isheetiin, tarkaanfii Ameerikaa kana keessatti kan hirmaatu biyyi kamiyyuu irratti deebii akka kennitu himteetti.

title: Ukraine’s offensive against Russia causes petrol panic across Central Asia
english: Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian oil refineries have caused severe fuel shortages and long lines at gas stations throughout Russia. This crisis has forced many Russians to travel into neighboring Kazakhstan to buy petrol, leading to a surge in cross-border smuggling despite official export bans. The ripple effects of this fuel scarcity are now negatively impacting energy-dependent nations across Central Asia, particularly Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan.
amharic: ዩክሬን በሩሲያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች ላይ በከፈተችው የድሮን ጥቃት ሳቢያ በሩሲያ ውስጥ የነዳጅ እጥረት ተከስቶ ረጅም ሰልፎች እየታዩ ነው። ይህ ችግር በርካታ ሩሲያውያን ነዳጅ ፍለጋ ወደ ጎረቤት ሀገር ካዛኪስታን እንዲሻገሩ ያስገደደ ሲሆን፣ የመንግስት የነዳጅ መላክ እገዳ ቢኖርም ድንበር ተሻጋሪ የነዳጅ ኮንትሮባንድ ንግድ እየተስፋፋ ይገኛል። የዚህ የነዳጅ እጥረት ቀውስ በአሁኑ ወቅት በመካከለኛው እስያ ሀገራት በተለይም በኪርጊስታን እና በታጂኪስታን ላይ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና እያሳደረ ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Yukreen buufataalee qulqulleessa boba'aa Raashiyaa irratti haleellaa xiyyaara koo'ee (drone) geggeessuun isaa, guutuu Raashiyaa keessatti hanqina boba'aafi hiriira dheeraa mooraa boba'aa irratti akka uumamu godheera. Rakkoon kun lammiilee Raashiyaa hedduu boba'aa bituuf gara biyya ollaa Kaazaakistaanitti akka imalan kan dirqisiise yoo ta'u, dhoorkaa boba'aa erguu seeraan taa'e irratti hundaa'uun seeraan alaa daangaa ceesisuun dabalaa jira. Hanqinni boba'aa kun amma biyyoota giddu-galeessa Eeshiyaa keessatti, keessattuu biyyoota akka Kirgistaaniifi Taajikistaan irratti dhiibbaa diinagdee cimaa uumaa jira.

title: US military says strike on alleged drug-smuggling boat kills two
english: The U.S. military recently conducted a strike on a vessel in the Eastern Pacific, resulting in two deaths, as part of an ongoing mission to combat drug trafficking cartels. While U.S. officials maintain the boat was involved in criminal activity, human rights groups and legal experts have raised concerns that these attacks may qualify as extrajudicial killings. The operation is one of many carried out under the Trump administration's aggressive strategy to disrupt regional narcotics trade.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውርን ለመቆጣጠር በሚል በምስራቅ ፓስፊክ ውቅያኖስ ላይ ባደረሰው ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች መገደላቸውን አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናት ጀልባው በወንጀል ተግባር ላይ የተሰማራ እንደነበር ቢገልጹም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ግን ጥቃቶቹ ያለፍርድ የሚፈጸሙ ግድያዎች ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በአሜሪካ መንግስት የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ አዘዋዋሪዎችን ለመዋጋት እየተወሰደ ካለው ተከታታይ ዘመቻ አንዱ ነው።
oromo: Humnooni waraana Ameerikaa karaa baha Galaana Paasifiikiitti doonii gurguddaa seeraan alaa gurguruun shakkame irratti tarkaanfii fudhataniin namoota lama ajjeesuun isaanii beekameera. Abbootiin taayitaa Ameerikaa dooniin sun hojii yakkaafi darbiinsa sammuu adoochoo keessa kan jirtu ta'uu ibsanus, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaafi ogeeyyiin seeraa tarkaanfiin kun ajjeechaa seeraan alaa ta'uu danda'a jechuun yaaddoo qaban ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun tarsiimoo mootummaan Ameerikaa gareewwan sammuu adoochoo gurguran irratti fudhachaa jiru keessatti kan galmee yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti namoonni 200 ol ajjeefamaniiru.

title: Dozens of coordinated arson attacks carried out across Thailand
english: Numerous simultaneous arson attacks have struck various locations throughout Thailand, resulting in significant property damage, including a 7-Eleven store. At least three individuals have sustained injuries as a result of these violent acts. Authorities are currently addressing the situation following this wave of coordinated strikes.
amharic: በታይላንድ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በአንድ ጊዜ በተፈጸሙ የቃጠሎ ጥቃቶች የንግድ ተቋማት እና የ7-Eleven መደብርን ጨምሮ በርካታ ቦታዎች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። በእነዚህ የጥቃት ድርጊቶች ቢያንስ ሶስት ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት የተቀናጀውን ይህንን ጥቃት ለመቆጣጠር እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Thailand keessatti iddoowwan garaagaraatti walitti aansuun ibiddi qabsiifamuun qabeenyi hedduun manca'eera, keessattuu suuqiin 7-Eleven jedhamu miidhameera. Hojiiwwan haleellaa kana keessatti namoonni yoo xiqqaate sadii midhamaniiru. Aangeyyoonni biyyattii haleellaa qindeeffame kanaan wal qabatee tarkaanfii fudhachaa jiru.

title: Macron and MBS attend Esports World Cup closing ceremony
english: French President Emmanuel Macron and Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman were both present at the closing event of the Esports World Cup held in Paris. This gaming tournament was established by Saudi Arabia as part of a multi-billion dollar effort to position the nation as a major leader in the global video game industry. Their joint appearance highlights the growing importance and international investment currently being funneled into the world of competitive gaming.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ፕሬዝዳንት አማኑኤል ማክሮን እና የሳዑዲው አልጋ ወራሽ መሀመድ ቢን ሳልማን በፓሪስ በተካሄደው የኢ-ስፖርትስ ዓለም ዋንጫ የመዝጊያ ስነ-ስርዓት ላይ ተገኝተዋል። ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ለዚህ ውድድር የፈጠረች ሲሆን፣ አገሪቱን በዓለም የቪዲዮ ጨዋታዎች ኢንዱስትሪ ውስጥ ቀዳሚ ተዋናይ ለማድረግ በቢሊዮን የሚቆጠር ዶላር ኢንቨስት እያደረገች ነው። ይህ የሁለቱ መሪዎች በአንድ ላይ መታየት፣ ለተወዳዳሪ የቪዲዮ ጨዋታዎች ዓለም እየተሰጠ ያለውን ትኩረት እና ከፍተኛ ዓለም አቀፍ የኢኮኖሚ ድጋፍ ያሳያል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Faransaay Imaanu'eel Maakroon fi ilma mootii Sa'udii Mohammad biin Salmaan sirna cufiinsa waancaa addunyaa I-ispoortii Paarisitti geggeeffame irratti argamaniiru. Biyyoon Sa'udii Arabiyaa I-ispoortii kana kan hundeesite yoo ta'u, industirii viidiyoo geemii addunyaa keessatti biyya dursituu ta'uuf jecha qarshii biliyoonaan lakkaa'amu baasaa jirti. Argamni hogganoota kanaa, damee I-ispoortii kanaaf xiyyeeffannoon guddaan akkasumas invastimantiin addunyaa bal'aan akkamitti akka kenname mul'isa.

title: Give Imran Khan proper medical care, cricket legends urge Pakistani gov’t
english: A group of 21 former international cricket captains has sent a formal letter to Pakistan’s Prime Minister, Shehbaz Sharif, demanding better medical treatment and humane conditions for imprisoned former leader Imran Khan. The signatories expressed concern over Khan's health and criticized the government for failing to follow a Supreme Court order to transfer him to a private medical facility. These cricket legends, including former rivals and teammates, are calling for immediate action to ensure Khan receives independent care and fair treatment.
amharic: ሃያ አንድ የቀድሞ የዓለም አቀፍ የክሪኬት ቡድን ካፒቴኖች ለፓኪስታኑ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሸህባዝ ሸሪፍ በጻፉት ደብዳቤ፣ በእስር ላይ የሚገኙት የቀድሞው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኢምራን ካን ተገቢውን የህክምና እርዳታ እና ሰብአዊ አያያዝ እንዲያገኙ ጠይቀዋል። የክሪኬት ኮከቦቹ የካን የጤና ሁኔታ እያሽቆለቆለ መምጣቱን በመግለጽ፣ መንግስት ወደ ግል ሆስፒታል እንዲዛወሩ የተሰጠውን የጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ትዕዛዝ ባለማክበሩ ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል። አትሌቶቹ ኢምራን ካን በአስቸኳይ ነጻ እና ተገቢ የህክምና አገልግሎት እንዲያገኙ አጥብቀው ይወተውታሉ።
oromo: Garee kapteinota kirikeetii durii 21 ta’an kanneen ta’an, ministira muummee Paakistaan Shehbaz Sharifiif xalayaa barreessuun, durii ministira muummee kan turan Iimraan Kaan mana hidhaa keessatti yaala fayyaa fi qabxii namaa ta’e akka argatan gaafataniiru. Jajjaboonni taphattootaa kun fayyaan Iimraan Kaan hammaachuu isaa fi mootummaan ajaja mana murtii olaanaa isaan gara hospitaala dhuunfaatti erguuf kenname akka hin raawwanne balaaleffataniiru. Taphattoonni kun Iimraan Kaan battala yaala fayyaa bilisaa fi qulqullina qabu akka argatan dhiibbaa gochaa jiru.

title: Transfer target Julian Alvarez booed by fans in Atletico Madrid win
english: During Atletico Madrid's recent match against Villarreal, Argentine striker Julian Alvarez faced significant hostility from home fans. Supporters booed and jeered the player throughout his appearance, seemingly unhappy with his desire to transfer to another club. Manager Diego Simeone confirmed the club instructed Alvarez to head straight to the locker room after the game to avoid further confrontations with the crowd.
amharic: በአትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ እና በቪያሪያል መካከል በተደረገው ጨዋታ፣ የአርጀንቲናው አጥቂ ጁሊያን አልቫሬዝ በደጋፊዎች ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞት ነበር። ተጫዋቹ ክለቡን ለቆ ለመሄድ ፍላጎት ማሳየቱ ደጋፊዎቹን ስላስቆጣ፣ ወደ ሜዳ በገባበት ጊዜ ሁሉ በፉጨትና በጩኸት ተቀብለውታል። ከአሰልጣኝ ዲዬጎ ሲሜኦኔ በተሰጠ አስተያየት፣ ግጭትን ለመከላከል ሲባል አልቫሬዝ ጨዋታው እንዳለቀ በቀጥታ ወደ መልበሻ ክፍል እንዲሄድ ክለቡ አሳስቦት እንደነበር ተገልጿል።
oromo: Tapha Atleetikoo Maadiriid fi Viyaariyaal gidduutti ta’e irratti, weerartuu Arjentiinaa Juuliyan Alvaareez irratti mormiin cimaan gaadduu garee isaa biraa qaqqabeera. Alvaareez gara kilabii biraatti jijjiiramuuf fedhii qabaachuun isaa gaadduu garee kanaa aarsuu isaatiin, yeroo taphichaaf gara dirree seene hundaatti sagaleen mormii fi afuuraan (boo) simatameera. Leenjisaa Diyeegoo Simeone akka ibsetti, walitti bu’iinsa irraa of qusachuuf jecha kilabichi taphichi erga xumuramee booda Alvaareez kallattiin gara mana kuusa meeshaatti akka deemu ajajeera.

title: Iran's currency drops to record low, tracking websites show
english: The Iranian rial has reached an all-time low, currently trading at over 2,000,000 units against the US dollar. Data from currency monitoring platforms confirmed this significant decline in the free market. This devaluation highlights ongoing economic difficulties faced by the nation.
amharic: የኢራን ምንዛሬ የሆነው ሪያል ከአሜሪካ ዶላር አንጻር ከ2,000,000 በላይ በመውረድ ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ዝቅተኛ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል። የምንዛሬ መረጃዎችን የሚከታተሉ ድረ ገጾች እንደገለጹት፣ ይህ የገንዘብ ዋጋ መቀነስ በነጻ ገበያ ውስጥ ተረጋግጧል። ይህም አገሪቱ እያጋጠማት ያለውን ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Maallaqni biyya Iran kan Riyaal jedhamu gatiinsaa gadi bu’ee, doolaara Ameerikaa tokkoof riyaala miiliyoona lamaa ol ga’uun seenaa keessatti sadarkaa isa gadaanaa irra ga’eera. Weebsaayitoonni gatii maallaqaa hordofan akka ibsanitti, hir’inni kun gabaa bilisaa keessatti kan mirkanaa’e dha. Kunis biyyattiin rakkoo dinagdee cimaa keessa akka jirtu kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Seville, Jefferson-Wooden roar to 100m wins at Silesia Diamond League
english: Jamaican sprinter Oblique Seville and American Melissa Jefferson-Wooden claimed 100m victories at the Silesia Diamond League with impressive performances. Other highlights included Alison Dos Santos defeating world record holder Karsten Warholm in the 400m hurdles and Armand Duplantis securing another pole vault win. Additionally, Canadian athletes dominated the hammer throw events while Marileidy Paulino continued her success in the 400m race.
amharic: የጃማይካው ኦብሊክ ሴቪል እና አሜሪካዊቷ ሜሊሳ ጄፈርሰን-ውደን በሲሌሲያ ዳይመንድ ሊግ በ100 ሜትር ውድድር አሸናፊ ሆነዋል። በሌሎች የውድድሩ ድምቀቶች አሊሰን ዶስ ሳንቶስ በ400 ሜትር መሰናክል የዓለም ክብረ ወሰን ባለቤቱን ካርስተን ዋርሆምን በማሸነፍ ሲቀድም፣ አርማንድ ዱፕላንቲስ በዘለላ ውድድር አንደኛ ሆኗል። በተጨማሪም የካናዳ አትሌቶች በመዶሻ ውርወራ ሲቆጣጠሩ፣ ማሪሌይዲ ፓውሊኖ በ400 ሜትር የሴቶች ውድድር ድልን ተቀዳጅታለች።
oromo: Atileetichi Jaamaaykaa Obliik Seviil fi Ameerikaattiin Melisaa Jeefarsan-Wuuden fiigicha meetira 100 Silesiyaa Daayamand Liigii irratti injifatan. Tapha kana irratti Aliisan Doos Saantos fiigicha gufuu meetira 400 irratti recordii addunyaa kan qabu Kaarsten Waarhoomiin injifateera, akkasumas Armaand Duuplantiis utaalcha dirrii (pole vault) irratti mo'ateera. Kana malees, atileetonni Kaanaadaa dargaa (hammer throw) irratti injifannoo argatan yoo ta'u, Maariileydii Paawuliinoos fiigicha meetira 400 dubartootaa irratti sadarkaa tokkoffaa qabatteetti.

title: US threat of ‘economic D-Day’ for Iran tests Trump’s China detente
english: The Trump administration is preparing to launch a new, aggressive sanctions campaign against Iran that aims to cut off all its economic support systems. This strategy creates a major dilemma because it would require the U.S. to target China, Iran’s primary trading partner, potentially damaging U.S.-China relations. Analysts remain skeptical about whether Washington will fully follow through on these threats, as doing so would mark a significant escalation in an economic war with Beijing.
amharic: የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በኢራን ላይ ሁሉንም የኢኮኖሚ ድጋፍ ምንጮች የሚያቋርጥ እጅግ አደገኛ የሆነ አዲስ የቅጣት ማዕቀብ ለመጣል ዝግጅት እያደረገ ነው። ይህ ስትራቴጂ የኢራን ዋና የንግድ አጋር የሆነችውን ቻይናን በዒላማው ውስጥ ስለሚከት፣ በአሜሪካ እና በቻይና ግንኙነት ላይ ከፍተኛ መዘዝ ሊያስከትል ይችላል። ተንታኞች አሜሪካ ይህንን ዛቻ እስከ መጨረሻው ትተገብረዋለች ወይስ አይተገበርም በሚለው ላይ ጥርጣሬ አላቸው፤ ምክንያቱም ከቻይና ጋር ያለውን የኢኮኖሚ ግንኙነት ማወክ ለዋሽንግተን ቀላል ጉዳይ አይደለም።
oromo: Mootummaan Trump, Iran deeggarsa dinagdee hunda akka dhabdu gochuuf tarkaanfii adabbii cimaa ta'e fudhachuuf qophaa'aa jira. Karoorri kun hiriyyaa daldala Iran kan taate Chaayinaa irratti xiyyeeffachuu waan gaafatuuf, hariiroo Ameerikaa fi Chaayinaa gidduu jiru irratti rakkoo uumuu danda'a. Ameerikaan dhaadannoo ishee kana hamma dhumaatti ni raawwatti moo hin raawwattu kan jedhu irratti qorattoonni shakkii qabu, sababni isaas Chaayinaa wajjin walitti bu'iinsa dinagdee keessa galuun Ameerikaaf of eeggannoo guddaa kan gaafatu waan ta'eef.

title: Mercedes no longer have the fastest car in F1, says leader Antonelli
english: Formula One championship leader Kimi Antonelli stated that Mercedes has lost its status as the fastest team following McLaren's recent performance improvements. While McLaren's Lando Norris disputed this claim by suggesting his own driving performance was a key factor in his recent victory, both acknowledge that McLaren has become a significant competitor. Despite the increased competition, Mercedes continues to lead the constructors' championship as teams prepare for upcoming races.
amharic: የፎርሙላ ዋን መሪ ኪሚ አንቶኔሊ እንዳሉት፣ ማክላረን ባደረገው የተሽከርካሪ ማሻሻያ ምክንያት መርሴዲስ የፍጥነት ብልጫውን አጥቷል። የማክላረኑ ላንዶ ኖሪስ ይህን ሃሳብ በመቃወም የቅርብ ጊዜ ድሉ በራሱ የנהጃ ችሎታ የተገኘ እንደሆነ ቢገልጽም፣ ማክላረን ለሻምፒዮናው ዋነኛ ተፎካካሪ መሆኑን ሁለቱም ተስማምተዋል። ውድድሩ እየጠነከረ ቢመጣም፣ መርሴዲስ አሁንም በኮንስትራክተሮች ደረጃ አሰጣጥ ግንባር ቀደም ሆኖ እየመራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hoggantuun qophii Formula One Kimi Antonelli akka jedhetti, gareen McLaren fooyya'iinsa konkolaataa isaanii booda Mercedes ariitiidhaan dorgomaa dursaa akka hin taane ibseera. Lando Norris kan garee McLaren ta'e yaada kana mormuudhaan injifannoon isaa dandeettii oofuudhaan kan dhufe ta'uu dubbateus, gareen McLaren dorgomaa guddaa ta'uu lamaanuu amanu. Dorgommiin kun daran jabaataa yoo adeemu, Mercedes ammas qabxii waligalaan dorgommii garee (constructors' championship) irratti dursee jira.

title: E1 settlement: Why Netanyahu, Israel’s right might not mind global outrage
english: The Israeli government has initiated the bidding process for a controversial settlement project in the E1 area of the West Bank, which would effectively divide Palestinian territory and prevent the creation of a future state. While this plan has sparked widespread international condemnation, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his far-right allies are using the backlash to appeal to nationalist voters ahead of upcoming elections. By framing global criticism as unfair external interference, these leaders aim to strengthen their political standing among right-wing supporters.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግስት በምዕራብ ባንክ ኢ1 በተባለው አካባቢ አወዛጋቢ የሆነ የሰፈራ ግንባታ ጨረታ ማውጣቱን ተከትሎ ዓለም አቀፍ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ይህ የሰፈራ ፕሮጀክት የፍልስጤም ግዛትን ለሁለት በመክፈል የወደፊት የፍልስጤም መንግስት የመመስረት ዕድልን አደጋ ላይ ይጥላል። ሆኖም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ እና የቀኝ ዘመም አጋሮቻቸው ይህንን አለም አቀፍ ተቃውሞ በመጠቀም፣ መጪውን ምርጫ ታሳቢ ያደረገ የፖለቲካ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት እየሞከሩ ይገኛሉ። የውጭ አካላትን ትችት በመቃወም ለደጋፊዎቻቸው ጠንካራ መሪ ለመምሰል እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el naannoo E1 jedhamu keessatti ijaarsa qubannaa seeraan alaa gaggeessuuf karoorfate mallattoon isaa addunyaa biratti mormii guddaa kaasee jira. Karoorri kun lafa Falasxiim bakka lamatti qooduun, gara fuulduraatti biyya Falasxiim hundeeffamuuf ceephoo ta'a jedhamee sodaatama. Ta'us, Ministirri Muummee Binyamin Netaaniyaahuu fi gareen isaanii mirga-qabiyyee, mormii idil-addunyaa kana fayyadamuun filannoo dhufuuf deeman injifachuuf of ijaaruuf yaalaa jiru. Ceephoo biyyoota alaa kana akka 'diinaa' fi 'dhiibbaa' saba irratti ta'eetti dhiyeessuun, deggartoota isaanii ofitti harkisuuf tattaaffii godhaa jiru.

title: Kazakhstan’s newly formed pro-government party wins parliamentary election
english: The newly established Adilet party has secured a major victory in Kazakhstan's recent parliamentary elections, winning over 71 percent of the vote. This result strengthens the political control of President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev under a restructured single-chamber parliament. While four other supportive parties also gained seats, the election serves to solidify the president's influence as he pursues his reform agenda.
amharic: በቅርቡ የተመሰረተው የአዲሌት ፓርቲ በካዛክስታን በተካሄደው የፓርላማ ምርጫ ከ71 በመቶ በላይ ድምፅ በማግኘት ታላቅ ድል ተቀዳጅቷል። ይህ ውጤት በፕሬዝዳንት ካሲም-ጆማርት ቶካዬቭ ስር ባለው አዲስ የተዋቀረ ነጠላ ምክር ቤት የፕሬዝዳንቱን የፖለቲካ ተፅእኖ የበለጠ ያጠናክረዋል። ምንም እንኳን ሌሎች አራት ደጋፊ ፓርቲዎች መቀመጫዎችን ቢያገኙም፣ ምርጫው ፕሬዝዳንቱ የጀመሩትን የሪፎርም መርሃ ግብር ለማስፈጸም ስልጣናቸውን እንዲያጠናክሩ ያስችላቸዋል።
oromo: Paartiin haaraa hundeeffame 'Adilet' jedhamu filannoo paarlamaa Kaazaakistaan irratti sagalee harka 71 ol argachuun injifannoo guddaa galmeesseera. Bu'aan kun aangoo paarlamichaatiin tokko qofa ta'ee ijaarame keessatti aangoo siyaasaa Preezidaant Kaasiim-Joomart Tookaayeeviif cimseera. Paartileen biroon afran deggartoota ta'an kunis teessoo argataniiru; ta'us, filannoon kun preezidaantichaaf sagantaa jijjiiramaa isaanii ittifufuuf humna guddaa kan kennuudha.

title: Israel probably committed war crimes in Gaza hospital double-tap, investigation finds
english: A recent investigation suggests Israel may have committed war crimes during a 2025 attack on Nasser Hospital in Gaza, which utilized a 'double-tap' tactic to kill 20 journalists, medics, and rescuers. Experts argue that the secondary strike, which targeted people responding to the initial explosion, violated international laws regarding civilian protection. While Israel claims the site was a military target, whistleblowers and investigators indicate that the operation was planned and disproportionate, prompting international calls for accountability.
amharic: አዲስ የተደረገ ምርመራ እንደሚያመለክተው እ.ኤ.አ በ2025 በጋዛ ናሰር ሆስፒታል ላይ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት እስራኤል የጦር ወንጀል ፈጽማ ሊሆን ይችላል። 'ደብል ታፕ' ወይም ተከታታይ ጥቃት በተባለው በዚህ ድርጊት 20 ጋዜጠኞች፣ የህክምና ባለሙያዎች እና አዳኞች ተገድለዋል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት፣ የመጀመሪያውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ ለደረሱ ሰዎች የታለመው ሁለተኛው ጥቃት ዓለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ መብት ህጎችን የሚጥስ ነው። እስራኤል ቦታውን ወታደራዊ ኢላማ እንደሆነ ብትገልጽም፣ የተለቀቁ መረጃዎች ጥቃቱ የታቀደ እና ተመጣጣኝ ያልሆነ መሆኑን በመጠቆም ተጠያቂነት እንዲኖር ጥሪዎች እየቀረቡ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Qorannoon dhihoo kun akka agarsiisutti, bara 2025 hospitaala Naasir kan Gaazaa keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa raawwatame keessatti Israa'el yakka waraanaa raawwachuu dandeessi. Haleellaa 'double-tap' jedhamu kanaan gaazexeessitoonni, ogeeyyiin fayyaa fi namoonni gargaarsa godhan 20 du'aniiru. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, haleellaan lammaffaan namoota haleellaa jalqabaatiif gargaarsa godhuuf ariifatan irratti raawwatame kun seera idil-addunyaa kan cabsedha. Israa'el bakki kun bakka waraanaa akka ta'e dubbatus, ragaan argame haleellaan kun karooraan kan raawwatamee fi kan hin madaalle ta'uu ibsuun, gaaffiin itti gaafatamummaa akka ka'u taasiseera.

title: Iran warns of 'consequences' for countries joining US economic sanctions
english: Iran has issued a stern warning that nations supporting upcoming United States economic sanctions will face repercussions. A spokesperson for the Iranian Foreign Ministry stated that any involvement in American efforts to isolate Iran's economy is viewed as an act of aggression. These comments were made as the U.S. prepares to implement new restrictive measures against the country.
amharic: ኢራን በአሜሪካ የሚመራውን የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ የሚደግፉ ሀገራት ተጠያቂ እንደሚሆኑ አስጠንቅቃለች። የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ቃል አቀባይ እንዳስታወቁት፣ ከአሜሪካ ጋር በመተባበር ኢራን ላይ የሚወሰድ ማንኛውም የኢኮኖሚ ጫና ውጤት ይኖረዋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰጠው አሜሪካ በአዲሱ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ዙሪያ በቅርቡ ይፋዊ መግለጫ ለመስጠት በምትዘጋጅበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Iiraan biyyoota sagantaa qoqqobbii diinagdee kan Ameerikaa deggeran irratti tarkaanfiin kan fudhatamu ta'uu akeekkachiisteetti. Dubbi himaan ministeera dhimma alaa Iiraan akka ibsanitti, biyyoonni Ameerikaa waliin ta'uun diinagdee Iiraan irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf yaalan hundi rakkoo keessa akka galan ibsaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan kenname Ameerikaan qoqqobbii haarawa labsachuuf qophaa'aa jirtuun wal qabatee dha.

title: In Sudan’s deserted Bara, blood waters its famous lemon trees
english: The Sudanese town of Bara, once famous for its lemon orchards, has been devastated by conflict, leaving streets filled with unburied bodies following the withdrawal of the Rapid Support Forces. Residents and experts are now warning of a public health catastrophe, as decomposing remains threaten to contaminate the town's shallow groundwater supply. Local reports indicate that hundreds of civilians were killed during the occupation, and the town currently faces severe destruction after months of intense fighting.
amharic: ቀደም ሲል በሎሚ እርሻዎቹ ይታወቅ የነበረው የሱዳኑ የባራ ከተማ በጦርነቱ ምክንያት ለከፍተኛ ውድመት ተዳርጓል። የፈጥኖ ደራሽ ኃይሎች ከተማዋን ለቀው ሲወጡ በየመንገዱ የተጣሉ አስከሬኖች ለከፍተኛ የጤና እክል እየዳረጉ ሲሆን፣ የበሰበሱ አስከሬኖች የከተማዋን የውሃ ምንጭ ሊበክሉ እንደሚችሉ ስጋት ተፈጥሯል። በከተማዋ በተካሄደው ውጊያ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ንጹሃን መገደላቸውን እና ከተማዋ በአሁኑ ወቅት የወደመች መሆኗን የደረሱ መረጃዎች ይጠቁማሉ።
oromo: Magaalaan Suudaan Bara jedhamtu, kan yeroo durii biqiltuu loomii isheetiin beekamtu, waraana hamaa erga booda guutummaatti barbadoofteetti. Waraanni 'Rapid Support Forces' magaalattii erga gadi lakkisee ba'ee booda, reeffi daandii irratti hafe balaa fayyaa uumuu danda'uufi bishaan dhugaatii magaalattii xureessuu akka danda'u gorsitoonni ni akeekkachiisu. Gabaasoonni akka mul'isanitti, yeroo waraanni kun magaalattii to'atee turetti namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman ajjeefamuu fi qabeenyi magaalattii barbada'uu ibsameera.

title: Nearly 90,000 told to evacuate as wildfire approaches Reno, Nevada
english: A rapidly spreading wildfire near Reno, Nevada, has forced approximately 42,000 residents to evacuate their homes, with another 45,000 warned to prepare for potential departure. Governor Joe Lombardo has declared a state of emergency as human-caused flames consume over 10,000 acres with zero containment. Six people, including three emergency responders, have sustained injuries while authorities work to manage the dangerous, windy conditions.
amharic: በኔቫዳ፣ ሪኖ ከተማ አቅራቢያ በተነሳው ከፍተኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎ ምክንያት ወደ 42,000 የሚጠጉ ነዋሪዎች ቤታቸውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ የታዘዙ ሲሆን ተጨማሪ 45,000 ሰዎችም ለዝግጅት እንዲቆዩ ተነግሯቸዋል። የሰው ሰራሽ የሆነው ይህ እሳት ከ10,000 ሄክታር በላይ መሬትን ያቃጠለ ሲሆን በደረሰው ጉዳት ሶስት የእሳት አደጋ ተከላካዮችን ጨምሮ ስድስት ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የአካባቢው አስተዳደር የአደጋ ጊዜ አዋጅ በማወጅ የብሄራዊ ጥበቃ ሰራዊትን በማሰማራት እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረገ ነው።
oromo: Magaala Reno, Nevada biratti ibidni bosonaa tasa ka'e namoota 42,000 ta'an ganda isaanii gadhiisanii akka ba'an dirqisiiseera, akkasumas namoonni biraa 45,000 qophii akka ta'an akeekkachiifameera. Ibidni namootaan ka'e kun hanga amma lafa hektaara 10,000 ol barbadeesseera, namoonni ja'a ta'anis madaa'aniiru. Bulchaan naannichaa Joe Lombardo labsiin hatattamaa kan labse yoo ta'u, ittisa ibidaa kana to'achuuf humnoonni eegumsa biyyaa hojiitti galaniiru.

title: King of Norway's health has worsened, palace says
english: King Harald V of Norway remains hospitalized for a bacterial blood infection, with the palace reporting a recent decline in his health. Although the 89-year-old monarch is responding to treatment, he will remain on medical leave and his son, Crown Prince Haakon, will continue to handle royal duties. This situation adds to a difficult year for the Norwegian royal family, which has dealt with various health concerns and personal scandals.
amharic: የኖርዌይ ንጉሥ ሃራልድ አምስተኛ በደም ኢንፌክሽን ምክንያት በሆስፒታል እየታከሙ ሲሆን የጤና ሁኔታቸውም መባባሱ ተገልጿል። ንጉሱ ለህክምናው ምላሽ እየሰጡ ቢሆንም፣ በህክምና እረፍት ላይ በመሆናቸው ስልጣናቸውን ለልጃቸው ለልዑል አልጋ ወራሽ ሃኮን አስረክበዋል። ይህ ክስተት በቤተ መንግሥቱ ለተከሰቱ የተለያዩ የጤና እና የግል ችግሮች የታጀበውን የአመቱ አስቸጋሪ ጊዜ ቀጥሎበታል።
oromo: Mootichi biyya Noorway Haaraald Shanaffaa vaayirasii dhiigaa keessatti argamuun walqabatee hospitaala kan jiran yoo ta'u, fayyaan isaanii hammaachuu mana mootummaa irraa ibsameera. Mootichi umrii isaanii 89 kan ta'e osoo yaalamaa jiranii hojii mootummaa irraa boqonnaa fudhataniiru; yeroo ammaa bakka bu'uun ilmi isaanii Haakoon itti gaafatamummaa baachaa jiru. Kunis maatii mootummaa biyyattii waggaa kana keessa rakkoolee fayyaa fi dhimmoota biroo mudatan keessaa isa tokko.

title: ‘Barrel bomb mufti’ Ahmad Hassoun handed life sentence in Syria trial
english: A Syrian court has sentenced former Grand Mufti Ahmad Hassoun to life in prison for his role during the country's long-standing war. The religious official was convicted of encouraging violence and providing ideological support for the crimes of the Bashar al-Assad regime. Hassoun, who served as a prominent figure under the previous administration, was captured in 2025 following his time in hiding.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞውን ግራንድ ሙፍቲ አህመድ ሀሱን በአገሪቱ ለረጅም ዓመታት በዘለቀው ጦርነት ወቅት ለፈጸሙት ድርጊት የዕድሜ ልክ እስራት ፈረደባቸው። ሃይማኖታዊው ባለሥልጣን የባሻር አል-አሳድ አገዛዝ ለፈጸማቸው ወንጀሎች ሽፋን በመስጠትና ጥቃትን በማነሳሳት ጥፋተኛ ሆነው ተገኝተዋል። ከ2005 እስከ 2021 ድረስ በኃላፊነት የቆዩት አህመድ ሀሱን፣ ከተደበቁበት ከተወሰነ ጊዜ በኋላ በመጋቢት 2025 በቁጥጥር ስር ውለው ነበር።
oromo: Mana murtii Siiriyaatti muftii duraanii Ahmad Hassoun waraana biyyattii keessatti gumaacha godhaniin hidhaa umurii guutuu itti murteesse. Hoggantoonni amantii kun mootummaa Bashar al-Assad jalatti yakka raawwatameef deeggarsa gochuu fi jeequmsa kakaasuu irratti yakka qaban jedhamee himatameera. Bara 2005 hanga 2021tti muftii olaanaa ta'anii kan tajaajilan Ahmad Hassoun, erga dhokattanii booda bara 2025 qabamuun isaanii ni yaadatama.

title: Trabzonspor president reacts to Salah disallowed hat-trick goal
english: Mohamed Salah made a strong debut for Trabzonspor in the Turkish Super Lig, scoring two goals during a 2-1 victory against Istanbul Basaksehir. Despite his impressive performance, he was denied a hat-trick after two of his goals were controversially disallowed. The club's president expressed significant frustration and disbelief regarding the refereeing decisions that prevented Salah from completing his third goal.

oromo: Mohamed Salah tapha isaa jalqabaa Kilabii Trabzonspor wajjin taphateen goolii lama lakkoofsiisee, gareen isaa Istanbul Basaksehir irratti injifannoo 2-1 akka argatu gargaareera. Pirezidaantiin kilabichaa murtee daanyotaa kanatti garmalee kan rifatan yoo ta'u, Salah goolii sadaffaa akka hin galchine ittifamuusaatti komii guddaa qabu.

title: How much more are you spending on petrol since the war in Iran began?
english: Following the start of the US-Israel war against Iran six months ago, petrol prices have climbed in at least 145 countries. This sharp rise in fuel costs is putting significant financial pressure on global consumers and disrupting supply chains. Because transport is essential to the economy, these higher prices are also causing food costs to increase worldwide.
amharic: የአሜሪካ እና የእስራኤል በኢራን ላይ የጀመሩት ጦርነት ከተቀሰቀሰ ወዲህ ቢያንስ በ145 ሀገራት የነዳጅ ዋጋ ከፍተኛ ጭማሪ አሳይቷል። ይህ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረት በዓለም ዙሪያ ባሉ ሸማቾች ላይ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና ፈጥሯል። የትራንስፖርት ዘርፉ ለአለም አቀፍ ኢኮኖሚ መሰረት በመሆኑ፣ የነዳጅ ዋጋ መጨመር የምግብ ዋጋ እንዲወደድ ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa fi Israa'el Iran irratti labsan erga jalqabee baatii ja'a keessatti, biyyoota 145 ol keessatti gatiin boba'aa dabalee jira. Daballiin gatii boba'aa kun baasii jireenyaa addunyaa irraatti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee jira. Geejjibni daldala idil-addunyaaf waan murteessaa ta'eef, gatiin boba'aa dabaluun isaa gatiin nyaataa fi meeshaalee biroo akka dabalu taasisee jira.

title: EU, Russian aircraft help Serbia battle wildfires
english: Serbia is currently battling intense wildfires fueled by extreme heat and drought across the region. To control the flames, the country has requested emergency assistance from both the European Union and Russia. International teams, including aircraft and firefighters from several nations, are now working alongside local personnel to protect vulnerable areas.
